examples.en: A true friend will always stand by your side.
examples.zh: 真正的朋友会一直站在你身边。

dict_entries.etymology: 由形容词 true（真实的）加名词后缀 -th 构成

examples.en: She finally told her parents the truth about the accident.
examples.zh: 她终于把事故的真相告诉了父母。

examples.en: The truth is that I forgot to bring my homework.
examples.zh: 事实是我忘了带作业。

dict_entries.etymology: 因衣服平铺时形状像字母 T 而得名

examples.en: He bought a white t-shirt at the shop yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天在商店买了一件白色T恤。

examples.en: She likes wearing a t-shirt and jeans on weekends.
examples.zh: 她周末喜欢穿T恤配牛仔裤。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自古英语 Tiwesdæg，意为「战神 Tiw 之日」

examples.en: We have a math test every Tuesday morning at school.
examples.zh: 我们学校每周二上午都有数学测验。

examples.en: The meeting has been moved from Monday to Tuesday.
examples.zh: 会议从周一改到了周二。

dict_entries.etymology: 因早期误以为这种鸟经土耳其（Turkey）传入欧洲而得名

examples.en: We always eat turkey with our family on Thanksgiving Day.
examples.zh: 感恩节我们总是和家人一起吃火鸡。

examples.en: She made a delicious sandwich with turkey and cheese.
examples.zh: 她用火鸡肉和奶酪做了一个美味的三明治。

dict_entries.etymology: 由动词 turn（转弯）加名词后缀 -ing 构成

examples.en: Take the second turning on the left after the bank.
examples.zh: 过了银行后在第二个路口左转。

examples.en: We missed the turning and had to drive back.
examples.zh: 我们错过了转弯口，只好开车折回去。

dict_entries.etymology: 由 twelve（十二）加序数词后缀 -th 变化而来

examples.en: Her birthday is on the twelfth of June every year.
examples.zh: 她的生日是每年的六月十二日。

examples.en: Our office is on the twelfth floor of this building.
examples.zh: 我们的办公室在这栋楼的十二层。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自古英语 twelf，本义为「十之后剩下二」

examples.en: There are twelve months in a year, as everyone knows.
examples.zh: 众所周知，一年有十二个月。

examples.en: The store opens at twelve o'clock on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 这家商店周日上午十二点开门。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自古英语 twentig，由「二」与「十」组合而成

examples.en: About twenty students joined the school music club this year.
examples.zh: 今年大约有二十名学生加入了学校音乐社团。

examples.en: The bus leaves every twenty minutes from the main station.
examples.zh: 公交车每二十分钟从总站发一班。

dict_entries.etymology: 由 twenty（二十）与序数词 first（第一）组合而成

examples.en: The twenty-first century began in the year two thousand one.
examples.zh: 二十一世纪始于2001年。

examples.en: Her flight leaves on the twenty-first of next month.
examples.zh: 她的航班下个月二十一号起飞。

dict_entries.etymology: 由 twenty（二十）与 one（一）组合而成

examples.en: My brother will be twenty-one years old next March.
examples.zh: 我哥哥明年三月就满二十一岁了。

examples.en: There are twenty-one players on the list for the game.
examples.zh: 这场比赛的名单上有二十一名球员。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自古英语 twiga，与 two（二）同源，-ce 为副词后缀

examples.en: I have visited Beijing twice in the past three years.
examples.zh: 过去三年里我去过北京两次。

examples.en: This new phone costs twice as much as my old one.
examples.zh: 这部新手机的价格是我旧手机的两倍。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自古英语 twinn，意为「成双的」，与 two（二）同源

examples.en: My twin brother and I often wear the same clothes.
examples.zh: 我和我的双胞胎哥哥经常穿一样的衣服。

examples.en: The hotel room has two comfortable twin beds by the window.
examples.zh: 酒店房间靠窗有两张舒适的单人床。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自古英语 twā，源自原始印欧语词根 *dwo-（二）

examples.en: There are only two seats left on the morning train.
examples.zh: 早班火车上只剩下两个座位了。

examples.en: The two friends walked home together after school every day.
examples.zh: 这两个朋友每天放学后一起走路回家。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自希腊语 typos，意为「印记、模型」

examples.en: What type of music do you usually listen to?
examples.zh: 你平时喜欢听什么类型的音乐？

examples.en: She can type very fast without looking at the keyboard.
examples.zh: 她不看键盘也能打字打得很快。

dict_entries.etymology: 由 under（在……下面）+ ground（地面）复合而成

examples.en: The shopping center has a large underground parking lot.
examples.zh: 这家购物中心有一个很大的地下停车场。

examples.en: We took the underground to avoid the heavy traffic downtown.
examples.zh: 为了避开市中心的拥堵，我们乘坐了地铁。

dict_entries.etymology: 由 under（在……之间）+ stand（站立）构成，原义为「置身其中而领会」

examples.en: I don't understand this math problem at all.
examples.zh: 这道数学题我完全看不懂。

examples.en: She speaks slowly so that everyone can understand her clearly.
examples.zh: 她说得很慢，好让每个人都能听明白。

dict_entries.etymology: 由动词 understand 加名词后缀 -ing 构成

examples.en: Reading widely helps deepen your understanding of the world.
examples.zh: 广泛阅读有助于加深你对世界的理解。

examples.en: My parents were very understanding when I failed the exam.
examples.zh: 我考试不及格时，父母非常体谅我。

dict_entries.etymology: 由否定前缀 un-（不）+ fair（公平的）构成

examples.en: It is unfair to blame him for the team's mistake.
examples.zh: 把团队的错误怪到他头上是不公平的。

examples.en: Many workers complained about the unfair rules at the factory.
examples.zh: 许多工人抱怨工厂里不公平的规定。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自拉丁语 unus，意为「一」

examples.en: We will finish the first unit of the textbook this week.
examples.zh: 这周我们将学完课本的第一单元。

examples.en: The meter is the basic unit of length in science.
examples.zh: 米是科学中长度的基本单位。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自拉丁语 universum，由 uni-（一）+ versus（转）构成，意为「合为一体的整体」

examples.en: Scientists are still exploring the mysteries of the universe.
examples.zh: 科学家们仍在探索宇宙的奥秘。

examples.en: The universe contains billions of stars and countless planets.
examples.zh: 宇宙中有数十亿颗恒星和数不清的行星。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自拉丁语 universitas，原义为「团体、整体」，词根 uni- 意为「一」

examples.en: She wants to study medicine at a famous university.
examples.zh: 她想去一所名牌大学学医。

examples.en: After graduating from university, he found a job in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后，他在上海找到了一份工作。

dict_entries.etymology: 由否定前缀 un-（不）+ known（已知的）构成

examples.en: The cause of the fire is still unknown to the police.
examples.zh: 警方目前仍不清楚火灾的起因。

examples.en: An unknown singer suddenly became famous after that TV show.
examples.zh: 一位不知名的歌手在那档电视节目之后突然走红。

dict_entries.etymology: 由中古英语短语 on lesse（在较少的条件下）演变而来

examples.en: You will miss the bus unless you leave right now.
examples.zh: 你要是不马上出发，就会错过公交车。

examples.en: Unless it rains tomorrow, we will have a picnic outside.
examples.zh: 除非明天下雨，否则我们就去外面野餐。

dict_entries.etymology: 由否定前缀 un-（不）+ like（像）构成

examples.en: Unlike his brother, Tom enjoys staying at home on weekends.
examples.zh: 和哥哥不同，汤姆周末喜欢待在家里。

examples.en: It is unlike her to be late for an important meeting.
examples.zh: 重要会议迟到可不像她的作风。

dict_entries.etymology: 由古诺尔斯语 und（直到）+ till（到）构成

examples.en: The library stays open until ten o'clock every night.
examples.zh: 图书馆每晚开放到十点。

examples.en: She didn't realize her mistake until the teacher pointed it out.
examples.zh: 直到老师指出来，她才意识到自己的错误。

dict_entries.etymology: 由否定前缀 un-（不）+ usual（通常的）构成

examples.en: It is unusual for him to arrive at school so early.
examples.zh: 他这么早到学校可真少见。

examples.en: The restaurant serves some unusual dishes from around the world.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅供应一些来自世界各地的特色菜肴。

dict_entries.etymology: 由 up（向上）+ on（在……上）复合而成

examples.en: Upon hearing the good news, she jumped up with joy.
examples.zh: 一听到这个好消息，她就高兴得跳了起来。

examples.en: The old castle stands upon a hill near the river.
examples.zh: 那座古堡矗立在河边的小山上。

dict_entries.etymology: 由 up（向上）+ stairs（楼梯）复合而成

examples.en: My bedroom is upstairs, next to my sister's room.
examples.zh: 我的卧室在楼上，紧挨着我妹妹的房间。

examples.en: He ran upstairs quickly to answer the ringing phone.
examples.zh: 他飞快地跑上楼去接响个不停的电话。

dict_entries.etymology: 来自动词 use 的过去分词，use 源自拉丁语 uti（使用）

examples.en: I used to play basketball with my friends after school.
examples.zh: 我以前放学后常和朋友们打篮球。

examples.en: She is already used to the cold weather in the north.
examples.zh: 她已经习惯了北方的寒冷天气。

dict_entries.etymology: 由 use（使用）+ 形容词后缀 -ful（充满……的）构成

examples.en: The teacher gave us some useful advice about learning English.
examples.zh: 老师给了我们一些学英语的实用建议。

examples.en: A map is very useful when you travel to new places.
examples.zh: 去陌生的地方旅行时，地图非常有用。
